## 3) Rise-Then-Crash Event Correlation
- Detection rule (Case1): past `720` bars rise in top `90%` and next `240` bars drop in bottom `10%`.
- Thresholds: rise >= `0.034136`, drop <= `-0.013873`
- Candidate points: `34793`, non-overlap events: `632`
